info.title: Mekong Logistics API
info.description: Cookie-authenticated first-party API. All tenant resources are explicitly organization-scoped. APP_URL and frontend share one public origin. Bootstrap CSRF cookies before mutations. See api.md for role matrix, pagination, errors and throttles.

get.summary: Search and list private business partners
get.description: partners.view. Active by default. Literal case-insensitive substring search across company names, code, email, phone, tax/registration identifiers, contact names/email/phone and location names/address line 1/cities. Wildcards are escaped; all filters are ANDed and tenant scope is retained. Name sort is case-insensitive; other sorts use NULLS LAST. ID provides stable tie ordering. Default page size 20.

post.description: partners.manage. No Mekong account or automatic cross-company sharing is created. organization_id and archived_at are prohibited inputs.

patch.description: partners.manage. Omitted fields are retained. Optional fields may be cleared with null. name, roles and country_code cannot be cleared. Archived partner edits return 409.

post.description: partners.archive. Idempotent. Archive retains child data, excludes the partner from the default list and blocks all profile/child writes with 409. Restore re-enables writes. There is no hard-delete endpoint.
